_comment: check-licenses.ps1 fails the build when a resolved dependency carries a
license that is not listed here. The list is deliberately narrow: every
entry has been considered for what it obliges this project to do.
Adding an entry is a deliberate act. If a new dependency needs one, that
is the moment to stop and read its licence.

Apache-2.0.obligation: Preserve copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices; state modifications. Patent grant included.

MIT.obligation: Preserve the copyright notice and permission notice.

BSD-2-Clause.obligation: Preserve the copyright notice and the two conditions.

BSD-3-Clause.obligation: Preserve the copyright notice, the three conditions, and do not use contributor names to endorse the product.

CC0-1.0.obligation: None. Dedicated to the public domain.
CC0-1.0.action: No action required; recorded for completeness.

Unicode-3.0.obligation: Preserve the copyright and permission notice; do not use Unicode names to endorse derived products.

denied.GPL-2.0: Copyleft: would force this application to be distributed under GPL-2.0.
denied.GPL-3.0: Copyleft: would force this application to be distributed under GPL-3.0.
denied.LGPL-2.1: Weak copyleft: requires relinking ability and notice; avoid in an application.
denied.LGPL-3.0: Weak copyleft: requires relinking ability and notice; avoid in an application.
denied.AGPL-3.0: Network copyleft: would impose source disclosure on server interaction.
denied.SSPL-1.0: Not an OSI-approved licence; restricts service provision.
denied.BUSL-1.1: Time-limited proprietary licence; not open source during its term.
denied.LicenseRef-Gemma: Custom licence: Google may change terms unilaterally and restrict use remotely. See docs/legal/MODEL_LICENSES.md.
denied.UNKNOWN: No licence declared. Treat as all rights reserved until proven otherwise.

_comment: Artifacts whose published metadata does not declare a licence, but whose
licence has been established from another authoritative source.
Each entry needs a source URL and a date; unverified entries are rejected.
Do not add an entry here to silence a failure you have not resolved.

com.google.guava:listenablefuture.reason: Published as an interface-only placeholder; no POM licence block. Upstream guava is Apache-2.0.
